_methodology.sourceNote: Estimated seasonal pattern based on typical London-Funchal (easyJet/TAP/Ryanair) return fares and Madeira villa/group-Airbnb nightly rates for a group of 8. Not pulled from a live fare or listing search - verify against Skyscanner/Airbnb before finalizing a booking.
